servinfo.title: Front Side-Impact Pressure Sensor Removal and Installation (10-Channel Air Bag System)

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the air bag system sensors can result in personal injury due to non-deployed air bag system in the event of an accident or accidental air bag deployment.

item.ptxt: Never impact or shake the sensors.
Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.
Always tighten the mounting bolts to specified torque when installing the sensors. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.

s1.ptxt: Remove front door trim and door sealing cover.
Disconnect front side-impact pressure sensor connector (1).
Remove front side-impact pressure sensor screws (2) and remove front side-impact pressure sensor (3) from front door panel (4).

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Side-Impact Pressure Sensor Inspection (10-Channel Air Bag System)

s1.ptxt: Check that none of the following faulty conditions exists.

item.ptxt: Bend, deformation or rust on front door panel

s1.ptxt: Tighten front side-impact pressure sensor screws (2).
Connect front side-impact pressure sensor connector (3) securely.
Install door sealing cover and front door trim.
